text:
alex.k: hi! first day — got my company MacBook Air M2 (serial CX1234XYZ). I completed the initial sign-in but MDM shows "Enrollment: Pending" and FileVault status says "not enabled". also i can't run Docker: getting "x86_64 binary requires Rosetta". i tried installing homebrew but it prompts for admin. who should i ping for temporary admin or a fast re-enroll?

mdm-bot: detected new device serial=CX1234XYZ, profile=enroll_pending. See https://idp.redwood.example.com/device-enroll for self-repair steps.

alex.k: thanks — tried the self-repair link, it asks for corp wifi (i'm on corp-guest right now). is corp-guest blocked for MDM provisioning?

dana.it: hey alex — corp-guest is isolated. Join corp-secure (or wired in office) to complete enrollment. if you're remote, connect to corp-vpn then run the re-enroll flow.

alex.k: ok switching networks now. one quick Q: fdesetup shows "FileVault is Off". is that expected until enrollment finishes?

ben.sre: FileVault usually gets enforced by the MDM profile after enrollment if your account has a bootstrap token. run:

```
/usr/bin/fdesetup status
sudo profiles show --type configuration
```

post the outputs here (paste only the short lines).

alex.k: pasted outputs:
```
FileVault is Off
```
and \`profiles show\` is long but the top shows "enrollment: pending" and "MDM server: jamf.redwood.local"

linda-devex: fyi if Jamf shows pending it may need a second step: open the Company Self Service app -> Devices -> Re-enroll. sometimes the DEP token needs refresh. dana can push a remote install.

dana.it: thanks linda. alex, can you open a quick IT ticket with serial and screenshot of the pending state? I'll try a remote push first. if that fails we'll provide a temporary admin elevation for 24h so you can install Rosetta and Docker.

alex.k: filed ticket #IT-4821 with screenshot and serial. also attaching the docker error: "exec format error: x86_64 required". need rosetta for a few things.

dana.it: got it. i'm kicking a re-enroll now. one thing to check while we wait: if you have FileVault off and we push profile, it may auto-enable and prompt to create a recovery key. if you're comfortable, proceed, otherwise ask us to hold.

mdm-bot: re-enroll job started for CX1234XYZ; job id 2026-03-09-87. status: queued -> in_progress.

alex.k: quick follow: i also need access to /Applications for Docker and to run `sudo spctl --master-disable` to allow dev certs. is that included in admin elevation?

dana.it: temporary admin will give you local sudo for installing packages. we still require requests in the ticket to document the reason (Docker, Rosetta, dev certs). we'll set an expiry and remote revoke.

ben.sre: post-re-enroll checklist (for reference):
- confirm MDM profiles: `profiles show --type enrollment` -> should say "Enrolled: Yes"
- check fdesetup: `fdesetup status` -> should say "FileVault is On" or show pending enablement
- install rosetta: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` (requires sudo)
- reinstall Docker for Apple Silicon from https://docs.docker.com/desktop/mac/apple-silicon/

alex.k: re-enroll completed! profiles now say enrolled and jamf shows device as managed. fdesetup still says Off though.

dana.it: looks like the MDM didn't force FileVault yet. i'm going to push the FileVault profile now — will also request a bootstrap token rotation to allow enabling without losing escrow.

mdm-bot: filevault_profile_push job id 2026-03-09-88 queued.

alex.k: thank you, appreciate the help. i can wait while you push.

dana.it: pushed. you should see a dialog to enable FileVault — if it asks for an account to enable, use your corp account (alex.k@redwood.com). after enabling, run `fdesetup status` and paste output.

alex.k: dialog showed up, enabled FileVault, got a key URL for recovery. `fdesetup status` now returns `FileVault is On.` :tada:

linda-devex: :party_parrot: welcome aboard and congrats on surviving first IT onboarding obstacle :)

dana.it: one last thing — your temporary admin has been granted and will expire in 24h. ticket updated IT-4821 with notes. if you hit any permission errors before it expires ping me directly.

alex.k: awesome, thanks everyone. installed rosetta & docker, confirmed containers run. if anything else pops up i'll open a new thread.

ben.sre: great — leave a quick note in the ticket about the steps you ran (rosetta install, docker version) so we can document for future new-hires.

alex.k: will do. thanks again!
